procedures.name: Alert-Centered Investigation
procedures.goal: Trace an initial security alert through entities, raw logs, a bounded timeline, and validated evidence.
procedures.description: Default investigation workflow shared by all ExCyTIn-Bench security-log investigations.
procedures.retrieval_text: Alert-Centered Investigation | Trace an initial security alert through entities, raw logs, a bounded timeline, and validated evidence. | entities: ALERT_ID INCIDENT_ID | logs: incident_alert identity_signin endpoint_process endpoint_file endpoint_network email firewall_network cloud_application

phases.name: Ground the environment
phases.goal: Confirm the active log catalog before choosing evidence sources.
phases.success_condition: Candidate tables and their valid fields are known.
phases.retrieval_text: Alert-Centered Investigation | Ground the environment | Confirm the active log catalog before choosing evidence sources.

phases.name: Locate the initial alert
phases.goal: Anchor the investigation in the alert described by the task context.
phases.success_condition: The initial alert and its time range are identified.
phases.retrieval_text: Alert-Centered Investigation | Locate the initial alert | Anchor the investigation in the alert described by the task context. | incident_alert | ALERT_ID INCIDENT_ID TIMESTAMP

phases.name: Extract evidence entities
phases.goal: Extract accounts, devices, network indicators, messages, files, and processes from structured alert evidence.
phases.success_condition: At least one scoped pivot entity is supported by alert evidence.
phases.retrieval_text: Alert-Centered Investigation | Extract evidence entities | Extract accounts, devices, network indicators, messages, files, and processes from structured alert evidence. | incident_alert | ACCOUNT_ID EMAIL_ADDRESS DEVICE_ID IP_ADDRESS MESSAGE_ID FILE_HASH PROCESS_ID

phases.name: Select an investigation branch
phases.goal: Choose email, endpoint, identity, or network investigation according to the supported entity types.
phases.success_condition: A branch is selected from evidence rather than keyword guessing.
phases.retrieval_text: Alert-Centered Investigation | Select an investigation branch | Choose email, endpoint, identity, or network investigation according to the supported entity types.

phases.name: Correlate events
phases.goal: Expand evidence only through Semantic Memory join keys and their required scopes.
phases.success_condition: Every cross-log pivot has a valid identifier and scope.
phases.retrieval_text: Alert-Centered Investigation | Correlate events | Expand evidence only through Semantic Memory join keys and their required scopes.

phases.name: Build a bounded timeline
phases.goal: Order the correlated evidence within the incident time window.
phases.success_condition: Relevant events are temporally aligned with the initial alert.
phases.retrieval_text: Alert-Centered Investigation | Build a bounded timeline | Order the correlated evidence within the incident time window. |  | TIMESTAMP

phases.name: Validate the conclusion
phases.goal: Require the final claim to reconnect to the initial alert through entities and time.
phases.success_condition: The answer is supported by an explicit, scoped evidence chain.
phases.retrieval_text: Alert-Centered Investigation | Validate the conclusion | Require the final claim to reconnect to the initial alert through entities and time.

procedures.name: Email Threat Investigation
procedures.goal: Trace an email alert through message, URL, sender, recipient, delivery, and remediation evidence.
procedures.description: Use when alert evidence contains a URL, email address, or message identifier.
procedures.retrieval_text: Email Threat Investigation | Trace an email alert through message, URL, sender, recipient, delivery, and remediation evidence. | entities: URL EMAIL_ADDRESS MESSAGE_ID | logs: email

phases.name: Anchor the email alert
phases.goal: Confirm the alert and structured email evidence before searching broad activity logs.
phases.success_condition: An alert-linked email, URL, or message entity is identified.
phases.retrieval_text: Email Threat Investigation | Anchor the email alert | Confirm the alert and structured email evidence before searching broad activity logs. | incident_alert | ALERT_ID URL EMAIL_ADDRESS MESSAGE_ID

phases.name: Resolve the message
phases.goal: Resolve URL or address evidence to a stable message identifier.
phases.success_condition: A message identifier is supported by email evidence.
phases.retrieval_text: Email Threat Investigation | Resolve the message | Resolve URL or address evidence to a stable message identifier. | email | URL EMAIL_ADDRESS MESSAGE_ID

phases.name: Inspect delivery and participants
phases.goal: Identify sender, recipient, delivery state, and message time.
phases.success_condition: Message participants and delivery state are established.
phases.retrieval_text: Email Threat Investigation | Inspect delivery and participants | Identify sender, recipient, delivery state, and message time. | email | EMAIL_ADDRESS ACTION STATUS TIMESTAMP

phases.name: Inspect post-delivery remediation
phases.goal: Determine whether and when the message was removed, quarantined, or otherwise remediated.
phases.success_condition: The post-delivery action is connected to the same message.
phases.retrieval_text: Email Threat Investigation | Inspect post-delivery remediation | Determine whether and when the message was removed, quarantined, or otherwise remediated. | email | ACTION STATUS MESSAGE_ID TIMESTAMP

phases.name: Validate the email chain
phases.goal: Reconnect the message, participants, and remediation evidence to the original alert and time window.
phases.success_condition: The claimed email entity is supported across alert and email logs.
phases.retrieval_text: Email Threat Investigation | Validate the email chain | Reconnect the message, participants, and remediation evidence to the original alert and time window. | incident_alert email | ALERT_ID MESSAGE_ID TIMESTAMP

procedures.name: Endpoint Process Investigation
procedures.goal: Trace an endpoint alert through device, process, command line, file, network, registry, and logon evidence.
procedures.description: Use when alert evidence contains a device, process, command line, file, or hash.
procedures.retrieval_text: Endpoint Process Investigation | Trace an endpoint alert through device, process, command line, file, network, registry, and logon evidence. | entities: DEVICE_ID DEVICE_NAME PROCESS_ID COMMAND_LINE FILE_HASH | logs: endpoint_process endpoint_file endpoint_network

phases.name: Establish device and time scope
phases.goal: Resolve the affected device and incident window before using process identifiers.
phases.success_condition: A device identity and bounded time window are known.
phases.retrieval_text: Endpoint Process Investigation | Establish device and time scope | Resolve the affected device and incident window before using process identifiers. | incident_alert endpoint_network | DEVICE_ID DEVICE_NAME TIMESTAMP

phases.name: Locate the process
phases.goal: Identify the relevant process, command line, account, and parent execution context.
phases.success_condition: The process is scoped by device and time, not PID alone.
phases.retrieval_text: Endpoint Process Investigation | Locate the process | Identify the relevant process, command line, account, and parent execution context. | endpoint_process | PROCESS_ID COMMAND_LINE ACCOUNT_ID FILE_NAME

phases.name: Expand endpoint evidence
phases.goal: Follow the process into file, network, registry, and logon activity where relevant.
phases.success_condition: Downstream activity remains tied to the same device, process context, and time.
phases.retrieval_text: Endpoint Process Investigation | Expand endpoint evidence | Follow the process into file, network, registry, and logon activity where relevant. | endpoint_file endpoint_network | FILE_HASH FILE_PATH IP_ADDRESS ACTION

phases.name: Build the process timeline
phases.goal: Order parent, child, file, and network events around the suspicious execution.
phases.success_condition: The execution chain is temporally coherent.
phases.retrieval_text: Endpoint Process Investigation | Build the process timeline | Order parent, child, file, and network events around the suspicious execution. | endpoint_process endpoint_file endpoint_network | TIMESTAMP PROCESS_ID COMMAND_LINE

phases.name: Validate the endpoint chain
phases.goal: Confirm the attributed device, process, and activity reconnect to the alert evidence.
phases.success_condition: No conclusion relies on an unscoped PID, device name, or shared indicator.
phases.retrieval_text: Endpoint Process Investigation | Validate the endpoint chain | Confirm the attributed device, process, and activity reconnect to the alert evidence. | incident_alert endpoint_process | ALERT_ID DEVICE_ID PROCESS_ID TIMESTAMP

procedures.name: Identity and Sign-in Investigation
procedures.goal: Trace an identity alert through accounts, sign-ins, risk events, directory actions, and cloud activity.
procedures.description: Use when evidence contains an account, UPN, SID, sign-in IP, or identity-risk signal.
procedures.retrieval_text: Identity and Sign-in Investigation | Trace an identity alert through accounts, sign-ins, risk events, directory actions, and cloud activity. | entities: ACCOUNT_ID ACCOUNT_NAME EMAIL_ADDRESS IP_ADDRESS | logs: identity_signin cloud_application

phases.name: Establish account and time scope
phases.goal: Resolve the account identifiers, tenant, source IP, and incident window.
phases.success_condition: The account and time scope are supported by alert or sign-in evidence.
phases.retrieval_text: Identity and Sign-in Investigation | Establish account and time scope | Resolve the account identifiers, tenant, source IP, and incident window. | incident_alert identity_signin | ACCOUNT_ID EMAIL_ADDRESS IP_ADDRESS TIMESTAMP

phases.name: Inspect sign-ins
phases.goal: Review interactive and non-interactive sign-ins, authentication outcome, application, IP, and risk.
phases.success_condition: Relevant sign-ins are separated from unrelated activity by account and time.
phases.retrieval_text: Identity and Sign-in Investigation | Inspect sign-ins | Review interactive and non-interactive sign-ins, authentication outcome, application, IP, and risk. | identity_signin | EMAIL_ADDRESS IP_ADDRESS APPLICATION_ID STATUS TIMESTAMP

phases.name: Inspect risk and administrative actions
phases.goal: Correlate risk events, directory changes, audit operations, and cloud activity.
phases.success_condition: Identity actions are tied to the scoped account rather than name similarity alone.
phases.retrieval_text: Identity and Sign-in Investigation | Inspect risk and administrative actions | Correlate risk events, directory changes, audit operations, and cloud activity. | identity_signin cloud_application | ACCOUNT_ID ACTION STATUS TIMESTAMP

phases.name: Correlate identity context
phases.goal: Compare account, IP, device, application, tenant, and time before attributing activity.
phases.success_condition: The identity correlation uses multiple scoped attributes.
phases.retrieval_text: Identity and Sign-in Investigation | Correlate identity context | Compare account, IP, device, application, tenant, and time before attributing activity. | identity_signin cloud_application | ACCOUNT_ID IP_ADDRESS DEVICE_ID APPLICATION_ID TIMESTAMP

phases.name: Validate the identity chain
phases.goal: Reconnect the attributed account activity to the initial alert and incident window.
phases.success_condition: The conclusion does not rely on an unscoped display name or shared IP.
phases.retrieval_text: Identity and Sign-in Investigation | Validate the identity chain | Reconnect the attributed account activity to the initial alert and incident window. | incident_alert identity_signin | ALERT_ID ACCOUNT_ID TIMESTAMP

procedures.name: Network Activity Investigation
procedures.goal: Trace a network indicator through direction, device, process, firewall, and threat-intelligence evidence.
procedures.description: Use when evidence contains an IP, URL, domain, port, protocol, or network connection.
procedures.retrieval_text: Network Activity Investigation | Trace a network indicator through direction, device, process, firewall, and threat-intelligence evidence. | entities: IP_ADDRESS URL DOMAIN PORT PROTOCOL | logs: endpoint_network firewall_network

phases.name: Establish indicator and direction
phases.goal: Resolve the network indicator, local/remote direction, protocol, port, and incident window.
phases.success_condition: The indicator meaning and traffic direction are explicit.
phases.retrieval_text: Network Activity Investigation | Establish indicator and direction | Resolve the network indicator, local/remote direction, protocol, port, and incident window. | incident_alert endpoint_network firewall_network | IP_ADDRESS URL DOMAIN PORT PROTOCOL TIMESTAMP

phases.name: Identify device and process context
phases.goal: Find the device and initiating process responsible for the connection when endpoint evidence exists.
phases.success_condition: The connection is tied to a scoped device and execution context.
phases.retrieval_text: Network Activity Investigation | Identify device and process context | Find the device and initiating process responsible for the connection when endpoint evidence exists. | endpoint_network endpoint_process | DEVICE_ID DEVICE_NAME PROCESS_ID COMMAND_LINE

phases.name: Inspect network controls
phases.goal: Correlate endpoint connections with firewall, DNS, bastion, or threat-intelligence activity.
phases.success_condition: Network-control evidence refers to the same indicator and time window.
phases.retrieval_text: Network Activity Investigation | Inspect network controls | Correlate endpoint connections with firewall, DNS, bastion, or threat-intelligence activity. | endpoint_network firewall_network | IP_ADDRESS URL DOMAIN ACTION STATUS TIMESTAMP

phases.name: Build the network timeline
phases.goal: Order alert, endpoint, and network-control observations around the suspicious connection.
phases.success_condition: The network activity is temporally coherent across sources.
phases.retrieval_text: Network Activity Investigation | Build the network timeline | Order alert, endpoint, and network-control observations around the suspicious connection. | endpoint_network firewall_network | TIMESTAMP IP_ADDRESS DEVICE_ID

phases.name: Validate the network chain
phases.goal: Reconnect the indicator, direction, device, process, and timeline to the initial alert.
phases.success_condition: No conclusion relies on a shared IP without device, direction, and time context.
phases.retrieval_text: Network Activity Investigation | Validate the network chain | Reconnect the indicator, direction, device, process, and timeline to the initial alert. | incident_alert endpoint_network firewall_network | ALERT_ID IP_ADDRESS DEVICE_ID TIMESTAMP
